In the Nxeon codebase at /opt/nxeon (Next.js app), I need to build a searchable dropdown/combobox UI component for a settings form field (currently rendered as a native HTML `<select>` in components/customer/GameSettings.tsx, around the `field.type === "enum"` branch). The field will have a LARGE list of options (300+ Minecraft version strings), so a searchable/filterable combobox is needed instead of a plain select.

Please check:
1. Does any existing component in components/ (search broadly: components/ui/, components/customer/, anywhere) already implement a searchable dropdown, combobox, autocomplete, or typeahead pattern? Look for things like a command palette, a game/OS template picker with search, an IP/region selector, etc. — anything with an <input> that filters a list of options as you type. Report the exact file path and component name/export if found.
2. What CSS/class conventions does this codebase use for form inputs and dropdown panels? (e.g. the `className="input"` convention I see used — where is `.input` defined, what other utility classes exist for panels/menus/overlays — check globals.css or tailwind config for a `.input`, `.card`, `.menu`, `.panel`-style class, and note the color tokens used, since the app uses a specific navy/violet dark theme design system already established with CSS variables).
3. Does the codebase already use a `usePopper`/`useFloating`/Radix/any positioning library for dropdowns, or does everything just use plain absolutely-positioned divs?

Report concisely (under 400 words) with file:line citations so I can build a new searchable combobox that matches the existing visual language and doesn't reinvent conventions that already exist. Do not modify any files — this is investigation only.

## Findings

**1. Existing searchable/filterable-dropdown patterns**

No dedicated `Combobox`/`Autocomplete` component exists in `components/ui/`, but three components already implement the exact pattern needed (input + live-filtered list dropdown):

- **`components/customer/AddressAutocompleteInput.tsx`** (best template) — `AddressAutocompleteInput`, lines 84–123. Wrapper `<div className="relative">`, an `<input className="input">`, click-outside-to-close via a `boxRef` + `mousedown` listener (lines 45–48, 76–82), and a results panel:
  `<ul className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full z-20 mt-1 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-navy-900 shadow-xl">` (line 102), with each option a `<button className="block w-full truncate px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm text-slate-300 hover:bg-white/[0.05]">` (line 105–116). This is a local (non-debounced-server) version away from being exactly what's needed — the file comment (lines 10–13) explicitly says this same shape was reused from `DomainSearch.tsx`'s box, so it's the codebase's established convention for "input that reveals a filtered dropdown."
- **`components/portal/CommandPalette.tsx`** — `CommandPalette`, lines 34–184. Full keyboard-nav (ArrowUp/Down/Enter, lines 135–145), `active` index highlighting, grouped headers. Uses `.glass` panel class + `.kbd` for the Esc hint. Heavier-weight (modal overlay), useful for keyboard-nav logic reference but overkill for a form field.
- **`components/customer/VersionPickerModal.tsx`** — `VersionPickerModal`, lines 30–110. Directly analogous domain (OS/version selection) but no search input — it's a full-screen modal list of buttons, not inline. Good visual reference for "selectable row" styling (`border-brand-400 bg-brand-500/10 ring-1 ring-brand-400` for selected, line 78–82) but not a combobox pattern per se.
- `components/customer/DomainSearch.tsx` (line 174–183) is the origin of the `.input` + absolute-positioned-results idiom that `AddressAutocompleteInput` copied.

**2. CSS/class conventions** — `app/globals.css`:
- `.input` (line 375–376): `w-full rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-navy-900/80 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-100 outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-slate-500 focus:border-brand-400/60 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500/20`
- `.card` (171–172): `rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.06] bg-navy-900/70 p-6 backdrop-blur-md`
- `.glass` (178–179): `rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-white/[0.03] backdrop-blur-xl` — used for modal/overlay panels (CommandPalette)
- `.kbd` (406–407): small mono badge, used for shortcut hints
- `.label` (379): uppercase micro-label above inputs
- Color tokens: `navy-900`/`navy-950` (backgrounds), `brand-400`/`brand-500` (violet-blue accent, focus rings, selected state), `slate-300/400/500` (text), plus a light-theme override block under `.tone-light` (lines 456+). No dedicated `.menu`/`.panel`/`.dropdown` class exists — dropdown panels are just `rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-navy-900 shadow-xl` written inline each time (as in `AddressAutocompleteInput` line 102).

**3. Positioning library** — None. `grep` of `package.json` found no `radix`, `@floating-ui`, `popper`, `downshift`, `cmdk`, or `headlessui`. Every dropdown (CommandPalette, AddressAutocompleteInput, VersionPickerModal) is a plain `absolute`/`fixed`-positioned `<div>`/`<ul>` with manual click-outside (`mousedown` + ref-contains check) and manual `Escape`/arrow-key handling — no positioning engine at all.

**Recommendation for the new combobox:** follow `AddressAutocompleteInput.tsx`'s shape almost verbatim (wrapper `relative` div, `.input` for the text field, absolute `ul` with `z-20 mt-1 rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-navy-900 shadow-xl`, click-outside via ref, `hover:bg-white/[0.05]` rows) since it's already the established idiom reused twice in this codebase, and borrow CommandPalette's arrow-key/Enter navigation (lines 135–145) since a 300+ option list needs keyboard selection, not just click.
